description:
Sites:
- crate-jmap-chat-server/src/space.rs:1352-1362 (invite-path members extraction)
- crate-jmap-chat-server/src/space.rs:1451-1461 (post-write TOCTOU re-read)

Both sites have the same shape:

    let members: Vec<Value> = spaces
        .into_iter()
        .next()
        .map(|s| {
            s.members
                .into_iter()
                .map(serde_json::to_value)
                .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
        })
        .unwrap_or(Ok(vec![]))
        .map_err(|e| JmapError::server_fail(e.to_string()))?;

The .unwrap_or(Ok(vec![])) is doing double duty: 'no Space found → empty members' AND 'Space found → propagate the Result of mapping members'. The outer type before unwrap_or is Option<Result<Vec<Value>, serde_json::Error>>. The reader has to parse three levels of nesting (Option, Result, Vec) and recognize that the Ok(vec![]) is the 'no-space' default, not an error-construction.

Idiomatic rewrites:

1. Use Option::transpose() to swap layers:

    let members: Vec<Value> = spaces
        .into_iter()
        .next()
        .map(|s| s.members.into_iter().map(serde_json::to_value).collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>())
        .transpose()
        .map_err(|e| JmapError::server_fail(e.to_string()))?
        .unwrap_or_default();

2. Or just early-return / match on the option:

    let members: Vec<Value> = match spaces.into_iter().next() {
        Some(s) => s.members.into_iter()
            .map(serde_json::to_value)
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
            .map_err(|e| JmapError::server_fail(e.to_string()))?,
        None => Vec::new(),
    };

What goes wrong if left: combinator code is supposed to read like English; .unwrap_or(Ok(vec![])) reads like noise. The maintenance cost is low (two sites, identical) but the pattern is exactly the kind of 'I gave up on the Option<Result> nesting and threw it at the wall' code that a code review on a senior Rust shop would flag. Both rewrites are mechanical and equivalent in performance.

Scope: P3 clippy. Real readability concern, not bikeshedding.
title: space.rs handle_space_join: .unwrap_or(Ok(vec![])) reads as line noise; rewrite as Option<Result>.transpose()
